closest_parent_model.justification: Out of the parent models, 'supervised' is the most direct and commonly used category for multilabel classification tasks as it captures the essence of learning from labeled data.

child_models.justification: Despite being broader overall, in the specific context of linear classification, 'linear binary classifiers' can be seen as a child when considering multilabel classification that simplifies into binary cases for practicality.
